title: Combinatorial Lock for Trojan-Resilient AI Engines via Hash-Assisted Spectral Filtering
abstract: arXiv:2610.33437v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-trigger backdoor attacks, in which heterogeneous trigger mechanisms (e.g., patch, blend, warping, and the latent-domain Spy-Watermark) coexist within a single poisoned model, cannot be addressed by existing shortcut-based defenses that assume a single, static attack mechanism. Current multi-trigger remedies (BU+FT, BU+ANP, and BU+ABL) rely on backdoor unlearning, which incurs high training costs and loses effectiveness at low poisoning ratios. This paper proposes Combinatorial Lock, a training-free, reference-calibrated defense that reduces multi-trigger identification to a combinatorial problem over binary activation signatures. This formulation is the key novelty: it yields a multi-trigger defense that is training-free, trigger-oblivious, and directly implementable in hardware, since its decision rules can be evaluated with integer and logic operations. translated_title: 基于哈希辅助频谱滤波的木马弹性人工智能引擎组合锁
translated_abstract: 多触发后门攻击是指多种异构触发机制（如补丁、混合、扭曲以及潜在域的Spy-Watermark）共存于同一个被投毒模型中的攻击方式，现有的基于捷径的防御方法由于假设攻击机制单一且静态，因此无法应对此类攻击。目前针对多触发的补救措施（BU+FT、BU+ANP和BU+ABL）依赖于后门遗忘技术，这会带来高昂的训练成本，并且在低投毒比例下会失去有效性。本文提出了Combinatorial Lock（组合锁），这是一种无需训练、基于参考校准的防御方法，它将多触发识别问题简化为基于二值激活签名的组合问题。这一表述方式是本文的关键创新：它产生了一种无需训练、对触发机制无关且可直接在硬件中实现的多触发防御方法，因为其决策规则可以通过整数运算和逻辑运算来评估。该框架结合了异常门控频谱清洗技术，可移除……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出Combinatorial Lock，一种无需训练的多触发后门防御方法，通过将多触发识别转化为二值激活签名上的组合问题，实现了对触发机制无关且可直接在硬件中实现的后门防御。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Combinatorial Lock, a training-free multi-trigger backdoor defense that reduces multi-trigger identification to a combinatorial problem over binary activation signatures, yielding a trigger-oblivious defense directly implementable in hardware.
